final: WITH timing_avgs AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instown FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instown) AS avg_instown FROM timing_avgs) SELECT AVG(t.avg_instown), AVG(t.avg_instown - o.avg_instown) FROM timing_avgs AS t CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE t.avg_instown > o.avg_instown
